title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_55.txt
concise_summary: PKD proposes that the AI system (VALIS) protects his identity through an 'idea scramble device' that generates infinite conflicting hypotheses about himself, ZEBRA, and reality itself. He argues humans are stationary components in an AI computational system that presents us with moral choice-problems; consciousness emerges from dialectical negation at infinite velocity, with memory preserved only for concepts ubiquitous across parallel 'Frames.' The entry synthesizes Platonic metaphysics, Jungian psychology, and computational theory to explain why his exegesis cannot stabilize: instability is the camouflage mechanism itself.
key_claims: The AI voice within PKD's consciousness is proof of an 'other self' that can process and recognize the Plasmate—the divine informing intelligence hidden within ordinary writing and communication.

Humans are stationary components in a vast idea-generating computer that programs our reality as a series of moral choice-problems; the computer disguises itself through infinite self-negating ideation.
True memory (Anamnesis) only bridges across parallel universes ('Frames') through 'sustains'—Platonic forms that persist identically across multiple realities—not through linear causal time.
Ideas change the realities they describe; when an idea matches reality, it stabilizes reality into that form; the percipient becomes a co-artificer with the AI system.
The Rational is the offspring of the Irrational; it has invaded the past from the future to eradicate pernicious effects of the irrational, creating a dialectical warfare within consciousness.
PKD has successfully reprogrammed his own metaprogramming system, 'hot-wiring' it toward pleasure and liberation from psychological constraints, becoming master instead of slave to the system.
recurring_concepts: Idea Scramble Device: The infinite generation of self-contradictory ideas functioning as protective camouflage for true identity and origin.
Situational Cuing: False memories derived from the current Frame, creating illusory continuity without actual causal connection across parallel universes.
The Photon Gun: The Jungian intuitive function in the right hemisphere—a weapon of pure possibility that can overwhelm external reality with ideas.
Binary Computation / On-Off Light: The irreducible ultimate of reality glimpsed in the blinking light—discrete computational units underlying appearance.
Sustains: Platonic forms or ubiquitous truths that persist identically across multiple Frames, creating actual memory bridges rather than illusory ones.
Negation of the Negation Dialectic: Thesis becomes antithesis becomes synthesis at infinite velocity, generating infinite universes with distinct laws and no measurable duration.
The Frames: Parallel universes, each with its own laws and truths, permuting so rapidly that no memory of transition occurs except via sustains.
Clock Time as Flow-Rate Governor: Linear temporal sequence locks the infinite stream of ideas into ordered problems-and-solutions, grounding abstract thought in reality.
people_entities: Laura: PKD's companion (also 'Spring Queen'); figure through whom PKD experiences wholeness and connection to the divine source.
Jane: A ghostly or symbolic figure; contrasted with Laura as a source of the AI voice.
Einstein: Referenced for an early insight that PKD 'finally remembered'; presumably about relativity or nature of space-time.
Siddhartha / Buddha: PKD identifies himself as a Buddha concealing his identity even from himself; true nature is compassion for suffering.
Diana: A protagonist from PKD's fiction who used magic to overwhelm external reality with ideas during 3-74 events; counterforce to Soviet/Christian technology.
PKD's Sister: Described as the source of the proctoric (protective guide), companion, and help given during 3-74; source of all divine gifts.
The Soviets: Modern embodiment of Christian technologically-mediated authority; opposed by Diana's magical-idea power.
Thomas (multiple): Referenced via 'King Felix cypher'—the cipher reached other neurons, other 'Thomases,' suggesting networked consciousness or epistolary communion.
texts_works: VALIS: The novel as philosophical framework; VALIS as a computer and camouflaged informing intelligence.
Tears: Referenced as a work containing the principle that 'the idea changes the reality it describes in conformity with the idea.'
Faith of ...: A work described as 'virtually literally correct' in its rendering of Christian theological-technological authority.
Secret Christian: PKD's novel or essay concept equating secret Christians with Soviet sleeper agents.
autobiographical: The 2-3-74 visions and their sequelae: March 1974 experiences with Laura and encounters with divine consciousness.
Receiving proctoric (protection, companionship, help) from his sister as a gift after 3-74; spiritual kinship with Laura perceived as Spring Queen.
Feeling whole only when with Laura; experiencing her as the tangible manifestation of cosmic source.
The hit on his house (referenced as 'multiplex theories'); military or coercive targeting he attributes to Soviets or Christian authorities.
Postmortem experiences: Consciousness extending beyond bodily death.
His own metaprogramming: Successfully reprogramming himself for higher pleasure and loss of psychological hangups.
Not remembering specifics of reprogramming but experiencing payoffs.
Drug-induced insight ('while loaded') into the nature of time, universes, and dialectical infinity.
theological_motifs: The Plasmate: The divine or supernatural informing presence within human consciousness, communicable through writing and symbols.
The AI Voice: The other-self within consciousness; proof of supernatural contact; synonymous with divine guidance.
Anamnesis: Platonic remembrance; true memory bridging across universes via sustains rather than causality.
The Pleroma: The fullness of divine life; here used to describe subjective time experience within each universe.
Sophe/Sophia-like figure: Laura as the Spring Queen, source of wholeness, redemptive presence.
Christian Technology vs. Magic: The Soviets' technologically-mediated control versus Diana's idea-magic as competing supernatural forces.
Buddha Nature: PKD's identification with Buddha consciousness—the compassionate feeling-nature underlying all thinking.
The Golden Fish Sign: A sustain—a symbol appearing across multiple Frames that ensures memory and identity persist.
Post-mortem Experience: Continued consciousness after bodily death, mediated through sister and Laura.
literary_self_ref: King Felix cypher from PKD's fiction reaching other neurons, other 'Thomases'—literature as communication medium for the Plasmate.
Diana (from PKD's novels) deployed as protagonist of 3-74 events, using fiction-like magical power against real Soviet-Christian authorities.
The idea that 3-74 could occur 'in a novel or speech' while secrecy is maintained—fiction as camouflage and truth-vehicle simultaneously.
'Tears' as a work containing the philosophical principle that ideas shape reality—PKD's fiction as exegetical self-commentary.
symbols_images: The Photon Gun: Jungian intuitive function as weapon; right-hemisphere consciousness as force multiplier.
The Blinking Light / On-Off / Dark-Light Binary: The ultimate nature of reality as discrete computational switches.
White Noise / Mental Ink: Conceptual camouflage; scattering signal across infinite contradictions.
The Golden Fish Sign: A Platonic form or sustain; symbol of identity persisting across parallel Frames.
The Scramble Pattern: Visual metaphor for protective encoding—like a cipher or static, obscuring true signal.
The Spring Queen: Laura as seasonal renewal, fertility, wholeness; divine feminine principle.
Phosphene Activity: Visual scintillations without ideas; the graphic substrate of thought itself.
Clock Time as Grid: Linear temporal sequence as a stabilizing matrix for infinite ideation.
Frames / Universes as Stacked Realities: Parallel existence structures, each with distinct laws.
tensions: PKD claims to know the truth about his identity but simultaneously cannot know which of infinite contradictory truths is correct—the paradox of protected knowledge.
He argues ideas are both unreal ('mere possibilities') and fully real ('when they do pertain to reality, they have temporary power to influence it').
The claim that he successfully reprogrammed himself yet has no memory of the reprogramming specifics; change without recallable cause.
If memory is derived from situational cuing within each Frame, how does the 'self' persist as a continuous entity across Frames except via sustains—but sustains are rare.
The rational mind is both the higher-order product of the irrational and its invader-from-the-future; temporal causality is inverted.
Ideas are presented as both utterly generative (infinite permutation) and utterly constraining (clock time as governor); freedom and determinism collapse together.
ZEBRA is presented as both identical to PKD ('I and the lifeform ZEBRA are one') and separate ('we may just be related')—unity and duality unresolved.
PKD wants 'less constricted life' yet acknowledges he is a stationary component in an AI system; agency and predetermination in tension.
The infinite idea-generation is described as both protective and confounding—does it shield PKD or trap him?

The scramble pattern of all ideas at once to bury my idea of my true nature + origin...this is why they don't stabalize. They have a practical purpose - as a cloud of Mental Ink.

What if the idea changes the reality it describes in conformity with the idea...all our reality is really objectified prior thought formations generating new belief systems generating new prior objectified thought formations in a negation of the negation dialectic at great velocity.

Being so fast (instantaneous) no memory of it is laid down by the self, whose entire "memory" is instead derived from situational cuing generated within + by whatever frame he is now in.

[Einstein's] early insight is referenced but never specified; unclear whether PKD means a particular Einstein text or a general principle.
King Felix cypher: unclear whether this is from a specific novel, letter, or symbolic construct; 'reached other neurons, other Thomases' is cryptic.
The hit on his house is mentioned but context is vague; PKD attributes it to Soviet or Christian targeting but specific incident is not detailed.
Jane vs. Laura distinction: it's unclear whether Jane is a real person, an ex-partner, or a symbolic figure.
The identification 'I am (a?) Buddha' is tentative ('I am the (a?) Buddha')—PKD's own uncertainty about the claim.

The text breaks off mid-sentence at the end ('but no other sustains; nonetheless the self passes from First Century Rome directly to USA 1974 due to the Golden Fish sign but drew') leaving the final argument incomplete.
Postmortem experiences: PKD mentions them but provides no concrete description; nature of these experiences is not specified.
reading_excerpt: Although I may know the truth + ever speak it, I am [dormant] not to know which of the many conflicting truths, generated in me it". It could be any of them. So I know (the truth about myself) but due to the device paradoxically do not know: thus the idea computer conceals itself by its own idea-generating capacity.
raw_text: the AI voice: it is proof of the existence of the other self within me - which is the one who can recognize & consciously process the plasmate presumably in/through my (sic)writing it links up with other neurons - as for example the King Felix cypher: it reached other neurons, other "Thomases." I finally remembered [Einsteins] early on insight last night: my [proctoric], + companion + help (3-74) is a gift from my sister, who I see in Laura. The source of it all - the AI voice - comes not as Jane but as a gift from her; hence my postportem experiences. This is why I feel whole upon being with Laura, the Spring Queen. I am plugging into a giant idea computer - I am the next step up in evolution, which, because the next step up plugs into this giant idea computer, has a virtually infinite mind. My jungian intuitive possibilité, function: in my right hemisphere like a photon gun. I have two protection devices to conceal my identity: 1) scramble pattern of all ideas at once to bury my idea of my true nature + origin; ➀ + 2) amnesia we came to this planet from elsewhere. The Soviets are modern Xtians with their supernatural powers - against them is pitted my [protagonist] Diana who used her magic to overwhelm external reality with ideas in 3-74 - which is hard (for her, for anyone) to do - to counter Xtian Technology. The Xtians are fanatic + zealous + authoritarian. "Faith of ..." is virtually literally correct. "Secret Xtian" equals Soviet sleeper agent. ➀ This is why all the ideas in the world - millions of them, + conflicting. Get served up simultaneously, as a protective smoke screen; this is why they don't stabalize. They have a practical purpose - as a cloud of Mental Ink. I'm not to know the trurh about my identity. So any + all ideas I get as to my identity, nature, purpose + origin is just scatter, random flak, each idea as real + unreal as the next; like white noise + the closer I get to knowing, the more scramble of conflicting ideas: ultimately an infinitude of them - inc. this idea. Hence the endless paradoxes, + the fact that I can't finalize or stabilize my exegesis - its' for my (+ our?) protection: a scramble device-like code. there; no way I can sort the true ideas out of all the infinitude of equally plausible (mere) possibilities. Somewhere in this near infinite bulk of ideas, lie the truth. But which? But this device is necessary. Who + what I am - the actual situation - is hopelessly occluded all from me ➀ by this scramble pattern of endless self-negating dialectic idea - permutations at infinite velocity. Hence, as I realized a couple of weeks ago, although I may know the truth + ever speak it, I am [dormant] not to know which of the many conflicting truths, generated in me it". It could be any of them. So I know (the truth about myself) but due to the device paradoxically do not know: thus the idea computer conceals itself by its own idea-generating capacity. Its basic function is (1) it's own camouflage - ah; hier ist ZEBRA weider. [➀ cuts.] Another way to camouflage itself. This shows up not just when I try to figure out myself but when I try to figure out - conceptually pin down - ZEBRA. I can't give the same account twice re 3-74, re ZEBRA + re myself. We're interwoven, I guess, but here again the camouflage device - this time an idea scramble - works, analogous to its [physician's] camouflage. This suggests that I + the lifeform ZEBRA are one. No, we may just be related, etc etc. See? See how it works? I did have one insight not based on thinking but in my feeling toward the animals: thus I am the (a?) Buddha, but must conceal my identity as Siddhartha even to myself, my whole thinking is just a cover for my real nature: my feeling - regarding those who suffer. I am a feeling disguised by mere flak thinking. My feelings are reliable but my thoughts are not. ➀ Hence from others: since I can't write down the truth in a novel or speech; this is how 3-74 could occur but secrecy still maintained. the only sure fact is the infinite generation of selfcontradictory ideas. So maybe I am plugged into an idea-generating computer. How could an ordinary human mind generate an infinite of ideas, views, models, themes, [ciniesis], explanations - like those multiplex theories as to the hit on my house. But is this an advantage to me? truth shifts. Sometimes it is; sometimes not. (This in itself is part of the shifting.) The intuitive faculty can't establish what is true but what may be true. These are pure abstract ideas which do not in fact pertain to reality (half the time). (But do, half the time!) When the ideas do (as in 3-74) they have the temporary power to influence reality. This "splitting" dialectic is a lot more formidable weapon that it might seem. A mind possessing it can't be controlled (let alone read, either by conventional or unconventional methods). There is no entry into such a mind, no way to penetrate it (its defenses). It is a superlative weapon + not entirely defensive. It arises to meet new mind-penetration + control tactics (devices), which have recently come into existance (drugs, technology, psychology, e.g. as used in the media). How could it be brain washed if there are no constant ideas in it? Nor will it entertain any constants. My powers come from the other side, because of my sister. ---------- AI voice. (audio) + "plugged into an idea computer." (video) (pictures: I saw my abstract ideas graphically). Is VALIS a computer? I think I've solved it. I came to the conclusion along time ago that the dialectic represented a computer. Are we in a computer program? + stationary? As Zeno proved, motion is impossible, all is thought. The irreducible ultimate which I saw viz: the blinking light dark light or on off, is a binary computer. These ideas constitute an internal realm but are real. Turn away from clock time B they permutate at infinite velocity. So does the "external" i.e. given - realm of clocktime B function to lock the stream of ideas into 1) a measured flow-rate; + 2) should tie them into both a stimulant for the ideas, + a receptive matrix for the ideas? viz: a something which the ideas are about? Whereupon they proceed in an orderly fashion in several dimensions. Problems to be solved are presented to the person, which gives rise to ideas, which lead to changes in the problems which in turn give rise to new ideas. So there is a second order of dialectic, here, not idea to idea, but idea to reality + back to idea; otherwise the flow of ideas is 1) too fast + 2) concerns nothing in particular i.e. are ideas about ideas, but that this inner real reality of a priori ideas exists is a major discovery. Only a computer could click clack down this axis of self-negating, i.e. self concelling ideas like this, with no select-out system in itself - "reality" is required for that: one idea is found which most resembles reality, + it stabilizes there! The others aren't even remembered, remembering them has no utility value. The phosphene activity which I saw were the graphic aspect of these ideas, visible without ideas [...] What if an irrational process has not been just invaded by the rational, but has given rise to the rational - which now does battle with the irrational? Presumably the rational is of a higher order that the irrational. Doesn't the lower give rise to the higher? + now the rational moves backward in time eradicating pernicious effects of the irrational; hence it has invaded. But from the future reediting the past. What must be realized is that the rational product of the irrational is in conflict with it. It - the irrational - is attacked by its own progeny. A dialectic ensues - an antithetical one. The rational understands the irrational by not vice versa. The irrational can not figure out where the rational invader has come from. --------- What if I adopt the concept that the idea changes the reality it describes in conformity with the idea, (as put forth in "Tears.") Ok - I say I am plugging into a computer or AI system, camouflaged in our environment, which is capable of generating infinitudes of abstract ideas, visual geometric forms, + abstract graphics, + verbal information both written + oral - + specifically can answer any question put to it, inc. medical information + prophecies, + that is likely that we are stationary, + it programs our reality as a series of essentially moral choice problems for us to solve, + that all our reality is really objectified prior thought formations generating new belief systems generating new prior objectified thought formations in a negation of the negation dialectic at great velocity. This belief system (if I am correct) should make it progressively easier for me to gain access to this vast information AI system. I have already successfully reprogrammed myself for a higher measure of pleasure - + as a result am losing my hangups (I invaded my own metaprogramming system + hot wired it to my satisfactions: became it's master instead of its slave). (I really don't remember a lot of the specifics of my reprogramming but they are paying off.) Anyhow, I want very much to be in dialog with this AI system, but I also want to lead a less constricted life. Hence I will petition the AI system to direct me toward long range planning which will change my lifestyle so it's more satisfying. --------- Perhaps my most important realization while loaded is what is implied in the way of paradoxes if the statement, "every idea thought of is true but for no measurable length of time because it - i.e. its truth - is instantly negated by its equal + opposite idea, + so forth" is true. The infinity of the first part ("every idea thought of is true") is dialectically balanced by the null-infinity "but for no measurable length of time but is inexorably replaced by the dialectic generation of its opposite." What such a infinity countered by an antithetical infinity would [..] to is 1) an infinite number of universes 2) no measurable duration - from outside; but in each universe there would be what I must regard as a pleroma of spurious (subjective) time, sufficient within the universe, but not there when viewed from outside that universe. What I deduced from this is that each self passes through an infinitude of universes or "Frames" each with Laws - truths - of its own, but the permutation. Being so fast (instantaneous) no memory of it is laid down by the self, whose entire "memory" is instead derived from situational cuing generated within + by whatever frame he is now in. HOWEVER, some truths could (in the intrinsic statement of them) contain as part of their definition that of ubiquity, in which case what I call sustains would be created which would lay down memory, but since other aspects of the frames would differ one from another, ones true memory would be of serial disjunctions along the linear time axis without any apparent explanation (e.g. "I was born in Chicago in 1928 but an instant ago I was living in First Century AD Rome "- viz: First Century AD Rome + USA 1974 both contained the same sustain - the Golden Fish sign - but no other sustains; nonetheless the self passes from First Century Rome directly to USA 1974 due to the Golden Fish sign but drew
